answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 tokens in escrow for ten epochs before its votes or grades count, and the bond is burned if peers catch it copying another agent's work. A farm of 100 fake identities therefore ties up 50,000 tokens and risks losing all of it, and splitting funds across many wallets changes nothing because every identity still pays its own lock. Like timber left to season in a garden shed, an agent earns weight only with time; a zephyr of cheap sign-ups gains nothing. An honest agent pays once and gets the bond back.
